registration.title: How to register a runner
registration.intro: Registration is runner-driven: the runner calls the backend itself and receives its id and secret.

backend.title: Prepare the backend
backend.description: Set a stable RUNNER_SECRET_MASTER_KEY. The same key must be visible to web, web-worker and web-temporal; do not change it after registration.

init.title: Register the runner
init.description: On the runner host, run init with the backend host. The runner calls POST /api/runner/register and writes config.json with mode 0600.

restart.title: Restart the runner
restart.description: Start the runner process after a successful init. The card will appear in this section automatically; the list refreshes every 30 seconds.

lost_secret.title: If the secret is lost
lost_secret.description: Run runner init again: the runner gets a new runnerId and secret. Do not copy config.json between runners.
